smallCountPolicyDecision.fullCoverageRule: when questionCount >= selectedKnowledgePointCount, preserve current all-selected-KP coverage and current even allocation semantics
smallCountPolicyDecision.smallCountRule: when 1 <= questionCount < selectedKnowledgePointCount, do not fail solely because every selected KP cannot appear in the same worksheet
smallCountPolicyDecision.allocationRule: select exactly questionCount distinct KPs from the canonical selected-KP list using a deterministic seed-derived rotation, allocate one question to each selected KP, and skip zero-allocation KPs
smallCountPolicyDecision.determinismRule: same blockId + generationSeed + questionCount MUST select the same KP subset
smallCountPolicyDecision.fairnessRule: different seeds MUST be capable of selecting different KPs so single-question practice is not permanently biased to the first canonical KP
smallCountPolicyDecision.normalCountPreservation: questionCount >= selectedKnowledgePointCount MUST retain existing canonical allocation order and 20/120 behavior; P1-08 remains 7/7/6 at 20 and 40/40/40 at 120 under the existing acceptance seed

requiring one question to satisfy all three P1-08 KPs
changing PatternSpecs or G4A-U04 arithmetic semantics
